posts.cooked: I'm guessing you're asking whether one-shots would go to the bottom of your deck. The card specifies "targets" get affected. Targets are cards with HP; these all remain in play until destroyed, and thus are "sustained on the field" in your terminology.

posts.cooked: Does the Skydeck thingy say "When a target would be destroyed, put it to the bottom of its deck instead"? Because if so, that's a bit like Unforgiving Wasteland's "When a target would be destroyed (by the environment), remove it from the game instead" which lets you get around stuff like Lilian's Fowl-destruction damage. But I suppose if it says "when a target is destroyed…" (as opposed to "would be destroyed"), then it still does its normal destruction stuff, just goes to the bottom of the deck afterwards rather than the trash.

Bumping this thread a bit to mention an issue we had with the Skydeck today - it entered play while we were fighting a flipped Dreamer. This meant that regarding her targets, there were two different "When this target is destroyed, put it somewhere that isn't the trash" thingys in play. I decided that the "Order of operations" thingy would be in force here, thus when a Projection was destroyed both the Dreamer's card and the Skydeck would try to put it not-in-the-trash at the same time, therefore we could choose and put it under the Dreamer's card to further our progress toward a win.

Is there any reason why this might be wrong, or did we do it right on this one?
